summary: Diff implements the new three-section router layout, Customer View generators, Upload Section, and an Admin Panel with secondary tabs plus related React Query hooks. Backend work adds comment list APIs and a migration module, but evidence suggests some key spec items are incomplete/incorrect: top-level nav always having 3 sections, per-user/device usage tracking, stable persistence across upgrades for new state, and inclusion of the required static background asset file.

missing_requirements.requirement: Top-level segmented navigation must show three primary sections (“Customer View”, “Upload Section”, “Admin Panel”).
missing_requirements.reason: TopSegmentedNav conditionally hides the “Admin Panel” segment when `isAdmin` is false, so the main navigation will not always show all three sections as required by the AC.

missing_requirements.requirement: Single/Bulk generation must mark comments as used for that specific user/device identity (per-user usage tracking), not globally for everyone.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend `Comment` has only a global `used : Bool` flag and `generateSingleComment` flips it to true without any per-caller/per-device tracking; caller is unused in the shown logic.

missing_requirements.requirement: Persist all data across canister upgrades using stable storage patterns (comment lists, used status, uploads, chat, bulk key, and usage tracking).
missing_requirements.reason: Backend shows `let commentLists = Map.empty<Text, CommentList>();` (non-stable) and comment used status stored in-memory; no stable variables or pre/post-upgrade persistence is evidenced in the shown portion. Also per-user usage tracking is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create the static pastel geometric/confetti background image under `frontend/public/assets/generated` and reference it from the UI.
missing_requirements.reason: UI references `/assets/generated/admin-bg.dim_1600x900.png`, but the diff summary does not show the actual image asset being added under `frontend/public/assets/generated`.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/maintained multiple unrelated site pages and novelty UI elements (e.g., teddy mascot, love story pages, music/video/gallery pages, animated hearts/sparkles background, proposal effects) not requested in the BuildRequest.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest is specifically about rebuilding the Comment Generator app UI/flows (Customer View / Upload Section / Admin Panel) and does not request these additional website experiences.
